claims.claim: Scrap power banks for sale in Ibadan
claims.evidence: Report shows two used black power banks but does not show location or confirm scrap status.
Report shows scuffed, taped casings but cannot reveal internal battery age.
Report does not show any power-on or charging test.
Report shows tape and residue that could suggest repair but does not prove it.

risks.risk: Devices do not power on or hold a charge
risks.proof: Video of each power bank turning on, charging a phone, and retaining charge.

risks.risk: Battery capacity is unknown or lower than expected
risks.proof: Photo of the mAh capacity label on each device.

risks.risk: Cables are only connected for demonstration and not included
risks.proof: Photo showing the braided cables detached and included with the sale.

risks.risk: Age and usage history are high
risks.proof: Photo of ports, labels, or proof of purchase showing age.
Photo of warranty card, manual, or original box.

proof_requests: Video of both power banks powering on and charging a device
Photo of the mAh capacity label on each unit
Photo showing whether the braided cables are included or only connected for demonstration
Photo of any model, brand, or serial labels
response.reason: The witness identifies the items as two black power banks in used condition, so they can be priced at worst case as non-working scrap pending proof of function.
